data.desc: SOAR AI, Inc. (NYSE American: SOAR) is an AI infrastructure and software company focused on the development and operation of AI infrastructure and AI-powered software solutions. The Company is constructing an AI infrastructure campus in Ohio that combines data center infrastructure, high-density GPU compute, high-performance networking and related technology to support AI, machine learning and high-performance computing workloads. The name SOAR, which stands for Sovereign AI Resources, reflects the Company's strategy of developing AI infrastructure that provides customers greater control over their data, models and computing environments. The Company also develops AI-powered operational systems for aviation businesses through its Aviation AI platform and operates Vaunt, a technology-enabled private aviation membership platform.
